jobs.description:
Be part of shaping what gets built, from idea to launch, at the intersection of AI and B2B SaaS.
At Proposales, we're transforming the way businesses create proposals. By replacing static documents with a new online standard, we're redefining how deals are done, turning proposals into interactive, web-powered experiences. Think of us as building a piece of internet infrastructure for sales.
Read about our mission: https://mission.proposales.com
We're now looking for a Product Engineer to join our team. This role isn't about executing tickets, it's about owning outcomes. You'll take a product from zero to launch by yourself, using AI agents as a core part of how you work. You understand the business scope, you know what needs to exist, and you have the skills to build it.
Your mission:

Take product initiatives from idea to shipped: scope, build, iterate, launch

Use AI agents as a genuine force multiplier, not just for boilerplate, but for real product development

Translate business problems into product decisions without needing someone to bridge the gap for you

Work closely with leadership and the product team to identify what actually matters to build next

Keep quality high; know when to trust what an agent produces and when to push back on it

What we believe in:
We're serverless first, hosted on Vercel with a monorepo built using Next.js and TypeScript.
We use AI where it clearly helps, in product and in internal tooling, and we care about reliability, safe handling of data, and keeping automation and human judgment in the right balance.
We value judgment over credentials, ownership over process, and shipping over speccing.
Some of the technologies you would be working with:

JavaScript / TypeScript

React, Next.js

Node.js

PostgreSQL

Vercel / Vercel AI SDK

MCP

LLM based tooling (Claude, Cursor, or similar)

A bit about you:

You think like a founder: you understand why something is being built, not just how

You're comfortable going from blank page to production without a detailed brief

You use AI tools daily and know how to get production quality output from them, not just prototypes

You have enough engineering depth to catch what agents miss and make sound architectural calls

You've shipped things: real things, that real people use

You value clarity and collaboration over rigid processes

Fluent in English (written and spoken)

You live in Stockholm and thrive in an office first team culture

Are you passionate about Cyber Security and ready to play a key role in a global organization's Zero Trust journey?
We are currently looking for an experienced Cyber Security Specialist for an exciting long-term consulting assignment based in Lund, Sweden, running through February 2027.
This is a fantastic opportunity to work with critical security platforms, collaborate with highly skilled professionals, and make a real impact on the security posture of a global organization.
About the Role
As a Cyber Security Specialist, you will work in an agile environment alongside other security experts to design, implement, operate, and continuously improve security capabilities that protect the organization's information systems and networks.
You will be involved in strengthening confidentiality, integrity, and availability across hybrid IT environments while contributing to the company's strategic Zero Trust transformation.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and manage security processes and technical capabilities within the Cyber Security domain

Operate, maintain, and enhance security platforms supporting the organization's Zero Trust strategy

Drive day-to-day operational security activities and initiatives

Monitor emerging cyber threats and industry innovations to continuously evolve security capabilities

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve security challenges

Contribute to maintaining a resilient and adaptive security posture across the organization

What We're Looking For
5+ years of experience in a similar Cyber Security role

Hands-on experience working with Zero Trust in an enterprise environment

Strong understanding of networking, operating systems, middleware/runtime environments, and security protocols

Experience working in hybrid environments including on-premises, private cloud, public cloud, and XaaS delivery models

Proven experience with Guardicore, Zscaler, or similar security technologies

Broad technical knowledge across infrastructure, networking, operating systems, and cloud technologies

Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with development teams

Solid understanding of Zero Trust principles and security best practices

Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken

Assignment Details
Location: Lund, Sweden Contract Duration: Until February 2027 Start: As soon as possible Assignment Type: Consulting Assignment
If you're looking for an opportunity to work at the forefront of Cyber Security and contribute to a large-scale Zero Trust transformation, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today or reach out for more information.
We review applications continually so please send in your application as soon as possible.
We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

OHB Sweden is a leading Swedish supplier of space systems. We develop, build, test and commission satellites and subsystems for a wide range of missions - including communications, Earth observation, and space research and exploration- serving both institutional and commercial customers within and outside Europe.
As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and justifying the mission's Ground Segment Architecture, leading specification and requirements definition activities while actively contributing to procurement and the management of contractor developments. You will play a pivotal role within the Flight Operations Team by planning, executing, and optimizing satellite operations, maintaining spacecraft health, leading real-time anomaly responses, and guiding a small team of engineers. Consequently, your technical scope will include defining onboard failure detection autonomy, drafting flight procedures and user manuals, and planning and leading ground-based System Validation Tests (SVT). Collaborating closely with internal teams and external partners to deliver robust solutions, this dynamic position demands strong leadership, exceptional communication skills, and the proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
It is desirable that you have a solid technical background in one or more of the following spacecraft engineering areas:

Data handling/Software

Ground Segment

Attitude and orbit control / Orbital mechanics

TT&C

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field

At least 5 years of experience in satellite system or subsystem engineering

Fluent in the English language, both spoken and written

Excellent interpersonal skills and communications capabilities

Strong understanding of TT&C, flight dynamics, and ground segment architecture

Experience with anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and recovery procedures

Legal authorization to work in Sweden

Added advantageous qualifications:

Experience with ESA programs and projects or other large international collaborations

Familiarity with scripting or automation tools (e.g., Python, Bash).

Knowledge of CCSDS & ECSS communication protocols

Experience of work in Mission Control during critical phases

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities

We’re looking for a proactive team player who learns quickly, provides technical guidance to colleagues, and can also work independently. Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and a pragmatic approach are essential - focusing on achieving the right balance of quality and timely delivery.
If you’re ready to be part of our journey and contribute to complex and exciting projects, we’d love to hear from you!

Join Telavox as a Security Engineer 🔐
Are you a hands-on security engineer who enjoys being close to the code, the systems, and the teams building them? At Telavox, security is not a gate at the end of development. It is an embedded capability that enables us to move fast, safely, and at scale.
Telavox is a fast-growing digital telco that combines the reliability of telecom with the agility of SaaS across Europe and across the globe. As our platform grows, security becomes a force multiplier, not just protecting what we build, but actively enabling engineers to ship better and safer software every day.
We are growing our Security Engineering team and looking for a Security Engineer to join our engineering organisation. You will work side by side with our Security Engineering Lead, sharing the same mission and many of the same activities, and bringing your own depth and perspective to the team. Together you will make security a built-in property of every system we ship, by making the secure way the easy way for every engineering team.
About the job
As a Security Engineer, you are part of the engineering execution layer that makes security real across the Platform organisation. You work across product and platform teams, building paved roads, secure defaults, and standards that teams adopt as their own, instead of doing every team's security for them.
You are a close partner to the Security Engineering Lead, who sets direction and priorities for the function. You complement each other: you share the work, challenge each other's thinking, and divide focus areas based on where your strengths are deepest. You also help bridge the gap between the CISO's strategic direction and day-to-day engineering reality, turning security goals into concrete engineering outcomes.
Your day-to-day work includes:

Build and evolve paved roads that make secure choices the default, such as vulnerability management workflows, secrets handling, and secure-by-default patterns in CI/CD

Work cross-functionally with engineering teams, understanding their context and helping them adopt security improvements in a way that fits how they build

Own and evolve vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning across our code and services, and make sure findings actually get fixed

Translate risks and requirements from customers, operators, audits, and the risk register into concrete, sized work for the right teams, and follow up so it lands and stays landed

Triage and coordinate responses to emerging threats: assess severity, involve the right teams, and drive issues to resolution

Share ownership of the security roadmap with the Security Engineering Lead, and take clear ownership of the areas where your experience is strongest

The role is based either at our new HQ in Malmö or in our Stockholm office.
About you
You are a pragmatic, hands-on security engineer who enjoys working closely with engineering teams and across team boundaries. You are comfortable moving between code, tooling, and architecture discussions, and you care about making security scalable, practical, and usable. You are just as comfortable working independently as you are in a small team where you and a colleague share responsibility for a broad area.
You believe security works best when it is distributed, automated, and embedded, not bolted on in the end. You lead through explanation and good defaults rather than gates and approvals.
You think ahead about what embedded security looks like when engineering is increasingly AI-augmented: agent credentials, MCP and tool-use boundaries, and secure-by-default workflows for code that humans and models write together.
We are looking for someone with:

A hands-on background in software or platform engineering, with real comfort in the terminal, able to run scans, inspect output, and file a PR when needed

At least 3-5 years of professional experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical role

Demonstrated experience with the security tooling landscape, such as vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning, understanding trade-offs, not just installation

Experience building shared tooling, standards, or paved roads that other engineering teams adopt

A teaching and enabling mindset: sharing knowledge, running hands-on deep-dives, and leaving capability behind rather than creating dependency

Strong ability to collaborate with engineers across teams, influence without formal authority, and translate security risks into practical engineering work

A collaborative way of working with a lead and peers, including sharing context, dividing focus areas, and giving and receiving honest feedback

Fluent English, written and spoken. Swedish is a plus

Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
How to apply!
At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English. 
For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Filip Ahlberg at filip.ahlberg@telavox.com
Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

Platform Team Lead
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time
The Role:
The Platform team creates the foundations that help Netlight’s builders start faster, ship safely, and work with confidence. Its scope spans cloud landing zones, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, service-catalogue capabilities, and AI tooling. We are looking for a Team Lead who can help a senior team turn these components into a reliable, easy-to-use platform.
You will protect the health of today’s services while helping the team invest in what comes next: production-grade cloud environments, clear self-service paths, stronger operational practices, and practical AI-assisted development. You will report to the Head of Tech and work closely with Operations and technical teams across Netlight.
At Netlight, the Team Lead role combines Engineering Manager responsibilities – people, technology, and business impact – with Product Manager responsibilities: problem discovery, stakeholder management, and prioritisation. You set direction, remove blockers, and make trade-offs visible. Goals, budget envelopes, and hiring decisions are shaped with the Head of Tech.

With your help, we want to:
- Make hard-won operational knowledge shared and documented, so reliability does not depend on one person’s memory.
- Develop Builder Experience Foundations into production-grade environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Build AI-platform tooling and workflows that help builders adopt AI-assisted development with confidence.
- Create clear standards, guardrails, and self-service onboarding so teams can build on solid foundations from day one.

Who you are
You can lead through ambiguity, turn competing needs into clear priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work.
You will thrive in this role if you bring:
- Strong prioritisation skills and a product mindset. You can balance operational requests, strategic investment, and team capacity.
- Experience building or running a platform as a product. You understand self-service, golden paths, service catalogues, clear ownership, and useful defaults – not only keeping infrastructure available.
- A self-directed, improvement-oriented mindset. You spot what can work better and turn that observation into focused action.
- A track record of advocating clearly for your team with leadership and stakeholders. You can challenge a commitment while keeping the conversation constructive.
- Strong communication skills. You explain technical trade-offs in business terms and turn business needs into choices engineers can act on.

Qualifications
We are looking for someone with:
- At least three years of experience leading software-engineering teams.
- Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, or a combination of these platforms. You do not need to be hands-on every day, but you should make informed calls and earn credibility with the team.
- A record of bringing structure to ambiguous, high-pressure situations and turning them into well-run operations.
- The ability to work from a Netlight office at least three days per week.
- Fluency in English.
- Swedish or German skills are a plus.

Nice to have:
- Experience with GitLab CI/CD or similar developer-infrastructure platforms.
- Experience working in a Developer Experience or Platform Building group, team, or area.
- Direct experience with AI coding assistants or custom LLM-based developer tooling.
- Familiarity with cloud cost governance or FinOps.

What you will do:
You will lead a small, senior platform team responsible for cloud landing zones, AI tooling, and builder-experience components including monitoring, CI/CD, and service catalogue capabilities. The team wants to invest more energy in cloud and builder infrastructure. Your leadership will help it do that while keeping shared services dependable.
You will work closely with the Head of Tech, Operations, and technical teams. Your key responsibilities will be to:
- Team leadership and development: Set direction, coach, and grow engineers. Build an environment where ideas, risks, and concerns surface early and feedback leads to action.
- Operational oversight: Maintain a clear view of cloud and builder-experience platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including GitLab and CI/CD. Build documentation and knowledge-sharing practices that make the platform resilient by design.
- Planning and execution: Shape the cloud-infrastructure and AI-platform roadmap. Balance stability work with the ambition to build strong builder infrastructure and guide the adoption of AI-assisted development tooling where it creates value.
- Communication and collaboration: Represent the team’s needs and constraints upward. Involve the team before making commitments that affect its scope, capacity, or working conditions.
- Culture and engagement: Build trust through consistency. Close the loop on feedback, follow through on commitments, and make room for different perspectives.

What we offer:
- The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry - and contribute to the continued growth of our thriving Stockholm office.
- Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
- Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
- A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
- Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
- Mental health & parental support offerings
- 30 days of paid vacation.

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
- Deutschlandticket
- Wellpass

Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
- 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
- Private pension savings

About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.

Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.

Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

Roxtec is the world-leading developer and manufacturer of modular-based sealing solutions for cable and pipe penetrations, serving customers in more than 80 markets worldwide.

As Business Area Marketing Manager, you will take on a strategic role within our Global Marketing team, with the opportunity to influence Roxtec’s market presence and contribute to our continued growth. The role combines a global perspective with close collaboration across the business.

Your role
In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to the Business Area organization, turning business strategies and priorities into relevant marketing initiatives. You will identify market opportunities and communication needs and ensure that Roxtec’s value proposition, solutions, and brand are effectively communicated to relevant target audiences. You will report to the Brand & Corporate Communications Manager.

Your responsibilities
• Developing market communication strategies, content, and activities tailored to priority target audiences.
• Creating, implementing, and monitoring global marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
• Managing and coordinating marketing communication projects from concept to execution.
• Collaborating with and supporting local marketing teams around the world.
• Strengthening collaboration between Global Marketing and the Business Area organization.
• Identifying communication priorities and recommending marketing initiatives that create measurable business value.

Your qualifications
• University degree in marketing or a related field.
• Several years of experience in strategic and operational marketing.
• Experience in an international B2B industrial or manufacturing environment is considered an advantage.
• Strong communication and project management skills.
• Experience working closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into marketing activities.
• Fluency in spoken and written English.

Who you are
You are business-oriented and proactive, with a strong understanding of how marketing and communication can support the business. You enjoy collaborating across functions and cultures and thrive in a dynamic environment.
Speed, simplicity, and flexibility are guiding principles in how we work at Roxtec and should feel natural to you. Read more about our Core Values here (https://www.roxtec.com/en/about-us/about-roxtec/roxtec-core-values/).

What we offer
• A strategic marketing role with an international scope.
• The opportunity to work closely with the business and influence our marketing direction.
• Close collaboration with colleagues across marketing, sales, product management, and business areas worldwide.
• A collaborative environment built on trust and continuous improvement.

Application
If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Annette Birgerson, Brand & Corporate Communications Manager, Global Marketing, +46 733 31 32 22, or Elin Jurjaks, HR Manager Sweden, +46 733 31 31 89. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-30.

Siemens Energy AB i Finspång söker en erfaren VVS-specialist med djup teknisk kompetens inom drift av ventilation, kyla och tryckluft.
Rollen är inriktad på att säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, energieffektivitet, driftsäkerhet och långsiktig funktion i tekniska installationer. 
Du arbetar nära driftorganisation, underhåll, verksamhet och externa leverantörer med felsökning, optimering, förebyggande underhåll och tekniska förbättringar.
Du har även en tekniskt sakkunnig roll i projekt och bidrar med kravställning, granskning och stöd från tidiga utredningar till driftsättning och överlämning.
För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara praktiskt orienterad, analytisk och van att självständigt lösa komplexa driftproblem med säkerheten i fokus.
Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter
Ansvara för teknisk driftuppföljning av ventilations-, kyl- och tryckluftssystem.
Analysera driftdata, larm, energianvändning och återkommande fel samt föreslå och genomföra förbättringsåtgärder.
Utföra kvalificerad felsökning och rotorsaksanalyser tillsammans med drift- och underhållspersonal.
Optimera systemfunktion, reglerstrategier, temperaturer, luftflöden, trycknivåer och drifttider.
Ta fram och utveckla driftinstruktioner, underhållsplaner, kontrollpunkter och teknisk dokumentation.
Medverka vid statusbedömningar, besiktningar, funktionsprovning, injustering och driftsättning av tekniska system.
Agera tekniskt sakkunnig i projekt genom att ta fram och granska tekniska krav, systemlösningar, handlingar och anbud samt säkerställa att drift-, underhålls- och energikrav beaktas genom hela projektet.
Ställa tekniska krav på entreprenörer och leverantörer samt följa upp att utförda åtgärder ger avsedd funktion.
Vara tekniskt stöd till verksamheten i frågor som rör inneklimat, processkyla, komfortkyla, ventilation och tryckluft.

Erfarenhet
Flerårig erfarenhet av teknisk drift, underhåll och felsökning inom ventilation, kyla och tryckluft, gärna från industriella anläggningar eller annan verksamhet med höga krav på tillgänglighet.
Kompetens
Relevant teknisk utbildning inom VVS, energi, driftteknik eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet.
Mycket god kunskap om ventilationssystem, luftbehandling, flödesbalansering, filter, fläktar, värmeåtervinning och styrning.
God kunskap om kylsystem, kylmaskiner, värmepumpar, köldbärarsystem, kondensorer och tillhörande reglerfunktioner.
God kunskap om tryckluftssystem, kompressorer, torkar, filtrering, distributionsnät, läckagesökning och energieffektiv drift.
Erfarenhet av styr- och övervakningssystem samt förmåga att tolka driftbilder, trendkurvor, larm och reglersekvenser.
Förmåga att utföra och bedöma mätningar av temperatur, tryck, flöde, luftkvalitet och energiprestanda.
Erfarenhet av energioptimering, förebyggande underhåll och tekniska förbättringar med ett tydligt livscykelperspektiv.
Det är meriterande med kompetens inom energi, exempelvis energianalys och energieffektivisering av tekniska installationer.
Förmåga att läsa och granska ritningar, flödesscheman, driftkort, funktionsbeskrivningar och tekniska manualer.
Kunskap om relevanta myndighetskrav och säkerhetsregler för VVS-, kyl- och tryckluftsanläggningar.
Personlig profil
Engagerad
Drivande
Djup teknisk kompetens och erfarenhet av drift inom ventilation, kyla och tryckluft
Ansvarstagande och strukturerad
Analytisk och metodisk vid felsökning
Bra initiativförmåga
Lösnings och förbättringsorienterad
Initiativtagande
Självständig

Language: English, Swedish
Mejla CV och en kort presentation till info@ndpconsult.se. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande.

Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
 Are you passionate about driving innovation and working on groundbreaking 5G and 6G mobile communication solutions? Do you thrive in a flexible working culture, where new insights are championed, and you are encouraged to develop new skills? Then join Ericsson and our team in Stockholm, Sweden. 
 We are looking for an FPGA Developer within the Ericsson Silicon organization. You will work with dedicated engineers passionate about developing world-class Radio and RAN Compute products. You will contribute to the FPGA team by developing and integrating high-performance FPGA solutions. 
 As part of our global organization, you'll collaborate with talented teams across our different sites. We are committed to Agile principles, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and teamwork. 
  
 What you will do:
  Design and implement FPGA-based Radio and RAN Compute solutions. 
   Develop and optimize FPGA designs for performance, power and cost-efficiency. 
   Apply industry-standard tools and methodologies for FPGA development and implementation. 
   Stay up to date with relevant FPGA technologies, tools and development methods. 
   Document design specifications, test procedures and results. 
   Participate in design reviews and contribute ideas to improve FPGA solutions. 
   Develop testbenches and test cases for your FPGA designs, following functional specifications, agreed verification plans and Ericsson development processes. 
   Use functional and code coverage results to identify verification gaps and meet agreed coverage targets. 
   Debug RTL issues found in simulation and on hardware, together with other designers. 
   Collaborate with hardware, software, systems and integration teams across Radio and RAN Compute development to understand product requirements and contribute to efficient solutions. 
   Contribute to the continuous improvement of products, tools and processes. 
  
 
 The skills you bring:
  A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or equivalent. 
   3–5 years of experience in FPGA/ASIC development, including RTL design and verification. 
   Solid knowledge of FPGA technology, design environment and methodology. 
   Hands-on use of FPGA design tools (e.g., Vivado, Quartus, or similar). 
   Proficiency in a hardware description language (HDL) such as Verilog or VHDL. 
   Working knowledge of interfaces and protocols such as DDR, AXI4, PCIe, SPI or I2C. 
   Scripting skills, for example in Python, Tcl or shell scripting. 
   Ability to create RTL testbenches to verify your own designs. 
   Familiarity with hardware architecture and digital signal processing. 
   Knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM experience is a plus. 
   An analytical, results-oriented approach with the ability to manage priorities and meet agreed commitments. 
   Good English spoken and written communication skills. 
   Self-motivation and the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with others. 
   Experience collaborating across teams and sites.

Key Requirements:
Degree in Quantity Surveying or Construction Cost Management. 
B.Sc. Construction Economics / Quantity Surveying with 4-5 years’ experience at Senior QS level
A proven track record in delivering complex projects on time and within budget
Chartered MSCSI / MRICS or embarking on the APC process
Time management and communication skills. 
Computer literacy and digital systems proficiency. Microsoft Office, Cubit / CostX, COINS
Reporting and administrative skills. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English 

As a Senior Quantity Surveyor, you will play a key role in the successful commercial delivery of projects, providing commercial leadership across cost management, contractual administration, and commercial governance. Through effective cost control, value management, procurement strategy, and commercial risk management, you will help drive strong commercial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
Working closely with project teams, clients, subcontractors, and other key stakeholders, you will support commercial decision-making across tendering, contract administration, commercial analysis, and project cost planning. Through collaboration and effective commercial management, you will contribute to positive commercial outcomes and the successful delivery of projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Reporting to the Commercial Director, your key responsibilities may vary depending on the nature and stage of the project being worked on, but can include: 
Tendering & Contract Administration 
Prepare and manage tender documentation, bills of quantities, tender pricing information and contract-related commercial documentation. 
Analyse subcontractor quotations and support commercially sound appointment decisions. 

Cost Planning & Commercial Management 
Manage cost control, value management and commercial performance across assigned projects. 
Support valuations, payment assessments, final accounts and retention management. 

Procurement & Subcontractor Management 
Advise on procurement strategy and support the development and management of project procurement schedules. 
Manage subcontractor packages, including tendering, appointments, payments, claims and final accounts. 

Commercial Risk & Change Management 
Identify and assess commercial risks and support the development of appropriate mitigation measures. 
Identify and manage variations, contractual claims, delays and disruption in accordance with contract requirements. 

Commercial Reporting 
Prepare and support commercial reporting, including cost value reconciliation, cash flow, material and subcontractor cost updates. 

Contract Management 
Support the administration of main contracts and subcontract agreements, ensuring contractual requirements and procedures are appropriately followed. 

Team Support 
Mentor and support junior and project Quantity Surveyors.  

Key Skills: 
Cost management, value management, and commercial risk management skills. 
Procurement strategy and commercial planning skills. 
Contract administration and contractual claims management skills. 
Tendering, estimating, and commercial analysis skills. 
Subcontractor management, valuation, and payment administration skills. 
Commercial reporting and analytical skills. 
Feasibility assessment and commercial advisory skills.

Role Purpose
Drive the optimization of metallurgical processes across the aluminium extrusion value chain. 
Ensure consistent product quality and strengthen operational excellence through expertise in alloys, heat treatment, and process performance. Collaborate with research, operations, commercial teams, customers, institutes, and universities to solve technical challenges and develop advanced aluminium extrusion solutions.
What you will be doing
Provide metallurgical expertise for aluminium extrusion operations, including casting, homogenization, extrusion, quenching, stretching, and aging
Develop, evaluate, and qualify new alloys, process technologies, and extrusion products
Develop and optimize alloy performance for mechanical and functional properties, extrusion productivity, and sustainability
Collaborate with production teams to establish process standards and best practices
Support customer projects with technical expertise and metallurgical guidance
Support root cause analysis and problem-solving for quality issues related to alloy selection, mechanical properties, and geometrical stability
Conduct metallurgical investigations, laboratory testing, and failure analyses
Prepare technical reports, specifications, and customer documentation
Ensure work is performed in compliance with the Hydro Quality system, HSE regulations, policies, and standardized operating procedures
Perform other tasks assigned by the responsible manager that support the operation of the unit and comply with applicable laws and company rules
Comply with area-specific customer requirements

What will make you successful?
PhD or Master’s degree in Physical Metallurgy, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline
Strong knowledge of aluminium alloys
Knowledge of heat treatment, precipitation hardening, recrystallization, grain structure control, and mechanical property development
Familiarity with metallography, microscopy, hardness testing, tensile testing, quality systems, ISO standards, and customer qualification requirements is preferred
Experience in aluminium extrusion, aluminium processing, or a metallurgical manufacturing environment
Practical experience with metallurgical testing and analysis techniques
Experience with automotive, building systems, industrial, electrical, or renewable energy applications is preferred
Knowledge of adjacent fields such as corrosion, extrusion simulation, or process modelling is an advantage
Familiarity with data analytics tools, including Power BI and Python, is an asset
Fluent English and Swedish both written and spoken
Curious, data-driven, and motivated to solve complex technical challenges
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Ability to combine deep metallurgical knowledge with practical manufacturing understanding
Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
Able to work effectively with research, operational, commercial, customer, and academic partners
Focused on measurable improvements in product performance, quality, operational efficiency, and customer success

What we offer you
A high-impact role in advanced manufacturing projects
Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies
International collaboration and exposure across sites
A dynamic and hands-on technical environment
Autonomy and responsibility in driving process improvements
Travel opportunities and involvement in on-site operations
A strong culture of quality, safety, and continuous learning

Your role
We are looking for a leader who is passionate about developing people, creating structure, and driving continuous improvement in a complex technical environment.
 
As Team Manager Infrastructure Office, you will lead a team of highly skilled specialists organized in two Scrum teams. The team plays a critical role in enabling and supporting one of Atlas Copco's strategic software platforms, providing the infrastructure, tools, and expertise needed to develop the next generation of connected products.
 
This is a leadership role where your success will be measured by your ability to develop people, create structure, drive continuous improvement, and ensure delivery in a business-critical environment.

Your responsibilities will include:
Leading, coaching, and developing the team and its individuals
Driving process development, quality assurance, and operational excellence
Managing recruitment, competence development, and resource planning
Overseeing the infrastructure, tools, and platform capabilities that support software development across R&D
Ensuring efficient operation of server infrastructure used for testing and software compilation
Supporting production testing and helping resolve business-critical customer issues where hardware and software intersect
Securing and developing key competencies within the team, including specialized Wi-Fi expertise
Collaborating with stakeholders across R&D to support current and future platform needs

 
You will be part of the department management team and contribute to the continued development of our software platforms, engineering capabilities, and ways of working. The Infrastructure Office is part of a newly formed department within R&D.

 
Your skills and experience
We believe you are an experienced leader who enjoys building high-performing teams and creating clarity in complex environments.
 
You bring:
Experience leading teams as a manager, project leader, or similar leadership role
A strong ability to drive change, improve processes, and establish efficient ways of working
Experience working in software development organizations
Understanding of embedded software development, Devops and Linux-based environments
Experience working with agile teams and Scrum methodologies
Strong communication, planning, and stakeholder management skills
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken

 
As a person, you are structured, collaborative, and able to balance operational priorities with long-term development. You empower others, build trust, and create the conditions for your team to succeed. You are comfortable leading experienced specialists and are able to navigate both strategic discussions and urgent operational challenges.
 
Your job location
 
This position is based in Nacka, Stockholm, Sweden. Extensive collaboration takes place across our global R&D organization, providing opportunities to work with colleagues around the world.
Application process
Our selection process includes interviews, skills assessments and a background check. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us.

Are you ready to take the next step in your career in auditing? We are looking for a Senior Audit Consultant with at least 5 years of professional experience to join our Audit Assurance team based in Stockholm. Regardless of your current level of experience, we offer an opportunity to grow and develop together with us.
The Opportunity:
 As an Audit Consultant, you will work on meaningful projects that give you significant influence over your workday. You will have the chance to grow with us and work with everything from small owner-managed companies to large listed corporations. You will become part of our global network of specialists and take on challenging tasks from day one. EY values teamwork, respect, and integrity, which form the foundation of our shared success.
Responsibilities:
Lead and execute audit engagements together with your team.
Maintain strong communication with key stakeholders and provide ongoing updates on the audit process.
Complete audit processes efficiently.
Continuously deepen your understanding of current regulations and processes, and share your knowledge to support and develop junior colleagues.
Understand our clients’ unique ambitions and needs, and share your insights with colleagues to improve our work.

Skills and Attributes for Success:
 We are looking for curious individuals ready to collaborate and build relationships with colleagues and clients. You should have a strong goal orientation and ambition to develop, as well as a passion for delivering professional service. In return, we offer support, coaching, and training to help you grow in your career.
Qualifications for the Role:
Relevant university degree
At least 5 years of professional experience in auditing
Experience working with audits for both large and small companies
Fluency in English (spoken and written)

What We Offer:
Continuous Learning: Develop skills for the future
Success Your Way: Tools and flexibility to make a difference
Transformational Leadership: Insights and coaching to become a leader
Inclusive Culture: Acceptance of who you are and the opportunity to help others

Are you ready to Shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
 Please submit your application no later than 24 December 2026. Selection and interviews are ongoing. For questions regarding the recruitment process, contact Adrian Lyng at Adrian.Lyng@se.ey.com. Start date by agreement. Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.
At EY, we promote an inclusive environment and value diversity. We encourage applications from candidates with different backgrounds and strive for a fair recruitment process. If you need support or adjustments, please contact us.

Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
Role Purpose
Be part of the medical technology revolution – Neko Health is expanding and looking for talented assistant nurses to join our team. Are you ready for an exciting career where you can make a real difference? This is your chance to become part of our dynamic team and help shape the exciting journey ahead!
In this role you will be at the center of our mission. Based at one of our futuristic Neko Health clinics in Central Stockholm, your main tasks will be to carry out examinations, collect clinical research data, take blood samples, analyse blood samples, and handle administrative documentation. You will be a key person in ensuring the smooth operation and high quality of our activities. You will work closely in teams with other skilled medical operators and experienced professionals, but you will also have the opportunity to take initiative and work independently.
We are looking for full-time assistant nurses who are comfortable working a variety of shifts, including daytime, evening, and Saturday shifts. The role requires a minimum commitment of one evening shift per week and one Saturday shift per month.
Minimum Qualifications
Relevant healthcare education as an assistant nurse.
Clinical skills: Confident in performing ECGs and blood sampling. Minimum of one year of clinical experience.
Excellent customer service skills: Warm, friendly, and professional approach. You are solution-oriented, flexible, and committed to delivering high-quality patient care.
Start-up mindset: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Adaptable to change and digitally proficient with good technical skills.
Strong communication skills: Clear, structured, and pedagogical in your communication.
Language skills: Fluent in Swedish and highly proficient in English.

We offer a dynamic work environment with a high degree of autonomy that fosters growth and development. If you are passionate about building a better healthcare system for everyone and you thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you.
Interviews are ongoing, so don't hesitate to send in your application today!

jobs.occupation: Cyber Security Engineer  Industrial Control Systems
jobs.description:
På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.
Denna position rapporterar till:
Digital Lead - Regional
__
You’ll join ABB Energy Industries, part of ABB’s Automation division. We deliver electrical automation and digitalization solutions to industries including nuclear power, district heating, hydropower, water, pharmaceuticals and chemicals, using ABB’s industry-leading technologies.
In this role, you’ll help deliver our cybersecurity portfolio and make a meaningful difference for our customers.
Your responsibilities
Design and implement secure OT solutions and interfaces with IT systems. Assess cybersecurity risks, identify security gaps and recommend effective remedies.
Develop robust system and network architectures.
Assess and document the cybersecurity posture of OT systems and network infrastructure.
Implement disaster recovery solutions for OT systems.
Deliver security updates and foundational security controls as part of service agreements.
Provide services such as IT/OT system hardening, role-based access control and risk assessments, helping customers meet cybersecurity standards and requirements, including the NIS2 Directive.

Your background
You have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or a related field—or equivalent experience. Most importantly, you bring practical experience with cybersecurity solutions and services, as well as OT/IT architecture or infrastructure.
Experience implementing cybersecurity solutions for control systems and/or SCADA is an advantage.
You understand network maintenance and troubleshooting, firewall configuration, routing protocols and network traffic monitoring.
Knowledge of Network Intrusion Detection (NID) and/or Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) is a plus.
Certifications such as GISP or ISA/IEC 62443 (IC32 or IC33) are advantageous.
You communicate confidently in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

More about us
Recruiting Manager Krishna Kumar can answer questions about the position at +46 21 34 30 78. Union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer – Amanda Törn, +46 72 464 40 66; Unionen – Tony Johansson, +46 730 66 99 06; Ledarna – Lenny Larsson, +46 706 32 85 47. For other questions, contact Talent Partner Irma Leijon at +46 72 461 23 14.
Apply by December 4. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

Nobina Group, the largest public transport operator in the Nordics, is looking for a driven and ambitious Strategy & Business Development Lead who wants to help shape the future of our business.
In this role, you will work closely with our executive management to drive strategic development, business growth and long-term value creation. It is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys complex challenges, turning insights into action and making a real impact.

The Role & Your Impact
As Group Strategy Specialist, you will drive the development of Nobina’s group strategy and business planning process, working closely with our CEO, CFO and executive management to translate strategic ambitions into concrete plans and initiatives.
You will coordinate the executive management agenda, prepare strategic analyses and decision-making material for executive management and Board meetings, lead group-wide projects and support potential M&A opportunities.
Key Responsibilities:

Drive the development of Nobina’s group strategy and business planning process

Coordinate the executive management agenda in collaboration with the CEO and CFO

Prepare strategic analyses and decision-making material for executive management and Board meetings

Lead strategic, group-wide and cross-functional projects

Support the evaluation and development of M&A opportunities

What You Bring
We are looking for an ambitious and analytical person with a strategic mindset and the ability to turn ideas into action. You are comfortable navigating complex challenges, combine a hands-on approach with a strong business perspective and enjoy building relationships and engaging stakeholders across the organisation. You are also flexible, solution-oriented and motivated by driving change and achieving results.
To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

4–5+ years of experience as a management consultant or within strategy, business development or project management in a relevant organisation

Proven experience leading projects and collaborating across functions

Experience presenting and engaging with senior management and board-level stakeholders

A university degree in Business, Engineering or a related field

Strong digital proficiency and experience using digital tools to support analysis and collaboration

Fluency in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

Why Nobina
At Nobina, we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where every employee feels valued. Our leaders take responsibility, make courageous decisions, and consistently embrace an outside-in perspective to meet the needs of our passengers. By being business-driven and focusing on the bigger picture, we strive to develop our operations and create sustainable solutions for the future. Our culture is built on respect, care, and responsibility, and we constantly seek new perspectives to drive innovation.

More and more people are choosing Sellpy and we need to keep up by adding one more German-speaking colleague to the Customer Support team.
We hope you are inspired to change the world for the better through your work and helping our customers with a wide variety of challenges.
Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We believe that every item deserves a second life, and we see huge financial, social and environmental value in making sure this happens. We look for those who share this vision and have the grit to tackle the challenges of building a circular future.
Customer Support at Sellpy
The next German-speaking colleague will have an important role in enabling customers in the German market. Sellpy has customers selling and buying second hand products, and our team is responsible for supporting customers in both areas, over chat, phone and email when required. We specialise in unique items at Sellpy, which gives you plenty of fun challenges that you probably haven’t faced before.
In short, you will
Create satisfaction for our buyers and sellers in a wide variety of support errands
Pick up inquiries via chat, telephone and/or email
Learn lots about second hand in a fast-paced environment
Help to improve our service based on customer feedback

Requirements
A structured and service-minded mentality
Spoken and written fluency in German, at a near-native level
Good knowledge of English as this is our company language
An interest in finding solutions and improving the offer for our customers

We’d be impressed if you have
Additional language skills (French, Czech, Danish or Dutch)
Experience in a customer-facing role
Experience in working in customer support via chat, phone and email
An interest in second hand

You get to
Be part of a modern company that's driving the change towards a sustainable lifestyle. In return, you will develop and work on meaningful challenges on a daily basis
Join a vibrant office culture at Medborgarplatsen
Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues
Enjoy staff discounts at Sellpy and the H&M brands (Arket, COS, Other Stories, Weekday & more)
Gain new skills with unlimited access to a learning platform

Location
On-site collaboration at our core, supported by a flexible hybrid setup. This specific role is based at our Medborgarplatsen office.
Form of employment: Full-time
Start: As agreed upon
Please note that only candidates who meet the requirement of spoken and written fluency in German will move forward in the screening process.

Freska – More than just a cleaning company 💙
Freska is one of Europe’s fastest growing cleaning companies with one clear goal: to become the best and most recommended workplace for service professionals. Our values — People first, Growth, and Responsibility — guide us every step of the way.

60% contract from the start!
Possibility of bonus
Collective agreement
Health benefits
Paid travel time between customers
Training and coaching in home cleaning
A supportive team and team leader
Direct office support during your workday
Steady schedule that locks seven days prior
Overtime compensated at 228 kr/ hour, with monthly payouts and no time bank!

You’ll be working in the most important place for our customers – their home. Tasks include vacuuming, dusting, and mopping. A good eye for detail is a big plus! You’ll use the Freska Pro app to manage your schedule, customer information, and stay updated with everything you need.

Speaks Swedish or English
Have experience in home cleaning
Can work flexibly between Monday-Friday 08:00–17:00

Apply now to be part of Freska! ✨
